summary: Frontend E2E verification of iteration_5 requirements (premium white theme, no gradients, section reorder, Video Links CRUD, admin theme sync, mobile app-like UX). 10 of 11 requirements PASS fully; 1 minor CSS ordering bug found (swipe hint hidden on mobile) and 1 cosmetic data-testid naming mismatch on the 'Care' tab. All admin flows, theme propagation to both public + admin CSS vars, and Featured Videos CRUD → home rendering verified. Settings restored to defaults; test data cleaned up.

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Swipe to read more' hint (.testi-hint) is NOT visible on mobile (390x844). Root cause: in /app/laravel/public/css/site.css the rule '.testi-hint { display: none; }' at line 1907 sits AFTER the @media(max-width:767px){ .testi-hint{display:flex} } block at lines 1877-1906, so with equal specificity the later rule wins and overrides the mobile override. Fix: move the default '.testi-hint { display: none; }' declaration ABOVE the @media block (or add !important, or wrap the default in @media(min-width:768px)).

Spec requested data-testid='tab-care' for the Care tab, but layout.blade.php line 76 uses data-testid='tab-services'. The tab label is 'Care' and it correctly navigates to /services, only the testid name differs from spec.

action_items: Move '.testi-hint { display: none; }' in /app/laravel/public/css/site.css to BEFORE the @media(max-width:767px) block (or change to display:none only when min-width:768px) so the mobile 'Swipe to read more' hint becomes visible on <768px.
(Optional/cosmetic) Rename data-testid='tab-services' -> 'tab-care' on the Care tab anchor in resources/views/frontend/layout.blade.php to match spec naming.
critical_code_review_comments: Section order: [data-testid=testimonials-section] correctly precedes [data-testid=doctors-section] in DOM (compareDocumentPosition confirms).
Header: no EN/HI [data-testid=lang-toggle] element found on public site.

Public home CSS custom properties resolve to --c-primary:#3b1f4a and --c-accent:#d64a3a (defaults). After admin change to #0b5fff, home <style> updated to --c-primary:#0b5fff AND admin layout injects --a-primary:#0b5fff — both public + admin theme sync verified. Restored to #3b1f4a/#d64a3a after test.

Body background is rgb(255,255,255) — premium white theme confirmed. Computed background-image on .hero, .doctor-card, .cta-band, .emergency-strip all report 'none' — no gradients present as required.

Cards have visible box-shadow via site.css lines 1864-1869 (var(--shadow-1) applied to .card-mh/.service-card/.doctor-card/.testimonial-card/.offer-card/.event-card/.blog-card/.doctor-featured/.hero-appt-card/.contact-wrap).

Mobile (390x844): [data-testid=app-tabbar] visible, tabs tab-home, tab-book (raised circular, border-radius 50%, bg rgb(214,74,58)=accent), tab-doctors, tab-call all present and navigable. tab-services (label 'Care') present but testid does not match spec 'tab-care'.
Mobile doctors grid: .doctor-grid computed gridTemplateColumns='354.812px' (single column) — 1 card per row confirmed across 4 doctor cards.

Mobile testimonials: [data-testid=testimonials-slider] renders with display:flex, overflow-x:auto (scroll-snap carousel). Desktop 1440: same element renders as display:grid with 3 columns of 378px — grid on desktop / slider on mobile working. BUT the 'Swipe to read more' hint stays hidden on mobile due to CSS source-order bug described above.

Video Links admin: [data-testid=admin-nav-video-links] exists in sidebar under Settings. Website Settings page no longer contains any youtube/instagram field (verified by name*=youtube / name*=instagram queries returning null). CRUD: created platform=instagram + url=https://www.instagram.com/reel/TEST_IG_1787067025/, title=TEST_UI Video → row appears in list → public home /featured-videos-section shows [data-testid^=featured-instagram-] href matching. Then deleted successfully. YouTube link https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dQw4w9WgXcQ renders as [data-testid^=featured-youtube-].

Regression: hero appointment form still has [data-testid=appt-doctor] and [data-testid=appt-date-visible]; date field is visible on 390x844 mobile (bounding box 43.6, 1181, 302.8x50). Featured doctor bio contains no literal '

' text (HTML rendered). No 'Translations' item in admin sidebar. Admin enquiry list still has no Source column (per iteration_4 verification, unchanged this iteration).

Admin website-settings has TWO forms on the page — target the settings form's Save via 'form:has([data-testid=ws-primary-color]) button[type=submit]' (per iteration_4 gotcha) to avoid triggering logout form. The mobile 'swipe hint' CSS ordering bug is the only remaining functional issue in iteration_5 scope.
rca of the issue: Mobile swipe hint hidden: in site.css the declaration '.testi-hint { display: none; }' (line 1907) is placed AFTER the @media(max-width:767px){ .testi-hint { display:flex; ... } } block. Both selectors have identical specificity (single class), so the later declaration in source order wins across ALL viewports — including mobile — nullifying the intended override. Fix by relocating the default hide rule above the media query, or scoping it under @media(min-width:768px).
